summary: Sensata Technologies Holding plc disclosed via Form 8-K the early tender results and amendment of cash tender offers for up to $350M, later increased to $400M aggregate principal amount, of certain outstanding senior notes issued by its subsidiaries STBV and STI. The offers target four series: 4.000% 2029, 5.875% 2030 (STBV) and 4.375% 2030 (STI). Terms include applicable acceptance priority levels, proration, and accrued interest in cash. The company is using a debt-for-cash tender to manage near-term maturities and reduce interest cost. Watch the proration levels and final settlement timing post-Expiration.
